name: Retro sci-fi painting
description: Dark painterly retro-futurist scenes in the manner of Moebius, Bekinski and 70s sci-fi covers: figures, vehicles and architecture in strange landscapes, plus human-and-machine moments.
light: low raking light, dusty ochre against cold blue-grey shade; one warm accent such as a window, sun or lamp
composition: vast landscape with a small figure or craft, strong diagonal or monumental vertical structure, layered depth with haze
camera_or_medium: gouache, airbrush or oil illustration with visible brush or ink line; European comics and 70s book-cover painting
mood: enigmatic, dreamlike, slightly melancholic; story implied but not shown
texture_detail: fine hatching, visible paint grain, worn surfaces, hand-drawn line; muted, earthy saturation
